lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular maxima are arranged in distinct vertical columns along the lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin, forming a semi-regular 2D grid of nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular blobs, creating grid-like intersection points across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and significant shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of small-diameter high-luminance spots that are notably smaller and more concentrated than the primary lateral flank blobs.
